free_parameters.name: num_q_heads
free_parameters.why: head count is not part of the witness; the target assert only reads block_idx.shape, so one query head keeps the CPU path minimal

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: KV head count is not part of the witness; it is only used by asserts after the target line

free_parameters.name: gamma
free_parameters.why: attention coverage ratio needed to enter get_active_blocks; the entry fails on the CPU-only GPU kernel before gamma can affect the target decision

free_parameters.name: tau
free_parameters.why: query-aware head threshold needed to enter get_active_blocks; the entry fails on the CPU-only GPU kernel before tau can affect the target decision

free_parameters.name: q_values
free_parameters.why: tensor values are irrelevant to the target assert, which reads only block_idx.shape and q_len/k_len shapes; zeros are deterministic

free_parameters.name: k_values
free_parameters.why: tensor values are irrelevant to the target assert; zeros are deterministic

free_parameters.name: v_values
free_parameters.why: tensor values are irrelevant to the target assert; zeros are deterministic

free_parameters.name: block_idx_values
free_parameters.why: only block_idx.shape (num_block) is read by the target assert; index values matter only below the target

execution.entry_reason: The official entry flex_prefill_attention is called first. On CPU it reaches get_active_blocks, which launches Triton GPU kernels (triton_bnhd_pool, triton_bhn_sumpool) before the target and fails with RuntimeError; mocking those would place stand-ins before the target. The driver therefore continues on the same official call chain with triton_block_wise_attention, which accepts block_idx directly and executes the real pre-target checks and the target assert unchanged.
